On the other hand, maybe the cashier was following some specific instructions or policies from their employer. Perhaps the store has a certain protocol that limits interactions to just ringing up items to maintain efficiency. In that case, it might not be the cashier's fault but rather a policy issue. There's also the aspect of job performance. If the cashier is focused solely on ringing up items quickly and accurately, they might prioritize that over social interaction.
